decisions: CONTRACT.md is 746 lines. It has sections 1 to 8 as briefed: 20 file formats in section 3, plus three formats added because two scripts share them (task-plan rows, role profile, queue item and verdict). spec/lib.md lists T1 to T98, failure cases included; T82 and T92 are marked needs-app.

One exit table for every script. 0 ok, 1 fail, 2 not-run, 3 tamper, 5 ready-wins, 6 deferred (retry next turn, no new fence or count), 10 reopened, 11-16 non-urgent watcher wakes, 20-27 urgent watcher wakes, 30 alarm, 64 stale ce, 65 stale epoch or step, 66 usage, 67 table-corrupt, 70 internal, 75 lock busy. Watcher wakes have a fixed precedence. guard-hook alone follows the harness hook protocol (0 allow, 2 deny).

Step machine: state is one of planned, active, parked, committed, cut, failed, dropped; step is one of none, fenced, stop-requested, stopped, admitted, started, bound. Fence reasons: first, stall, hang, loop, crash, memory, handover, cut, drop. Each call names the epoch and the step it expects. The fence is a compare-and-set in lib. A stop that has been confirmed sets the end state (failed, cut, dropped or parked). The limit path fences and exits 1.
Commit records are one per (task, step), at store/commits/<task>.<step>.json, using the steps listed in the task row. This lets a same-window review under F1(a) be a second step of the research task.

Events are ledger lines of kind event, so there is no events.jsonl. The design's coord.json is split three ways: coord.json (written by handover), acked.json (written by status --endturn) and alarm.json (written by watch --alarm). The alarm re-arms itself by killing the previous alarm after checking its pid, start time and command line. endturn only checks.

All time-based quantities that the design counts use counters. Stall counts model calls, hang counts watcher ticks, and the common-cause window is W_cc_ticks = 30, with the tick stored on each failure entry. A tick is one completed sleep of length delta. Library functions take now, free memory, uptime and the process provider as parameters.

Single-writer split: the session writes staging/ except staging/harvested/, which belongs to harvest. view/rejected.json belongs to commit. Witness results go to store/witness.jsonl, and only promote writes store/status/. replace alone builds review-in/ and copies in plants made by seed.mjs plant. check-queue makes seeds through seed.mjs's exported makeSeed. Queue items have opaque i_ ids, and seed s_ ids exist only under sealed/.

Admission does not call fsck or selftest. It requires a passing fsck ledger line newer than the last intake or commit, and a selftest line for the current treeSha(tcb/). reservation() and slotCount() live in lib so that admit and status share them. Unknown liveness counts toward slots as a safe default.

Transcript parser: a model call is one distinct message.id, with usage taken from its last record. Calls whose model is <synthetic> are excluded. Structured results come from StructuredOutput inputs and from attachment records of type structured_output. Helpers are the agent-*.jsonl files under <session>/subagents/. projectDirName follows the probe's encoding and is marked as believed.

The validator supports a closed subset of JSON Schema 2020-12 plus x-maxWords for word caps. It rejects any keyword outside the subset with exit 70, so a schema cannot silently use a keyword the validator ignores.

Smaller decisions. Rows are created only by replace plan, from plan/tasks-plan.json. Owner rulings and meter readings enter the ledger through status.mjs owner and status.mjs meter. The owner's tcb commit is recorded by handover init. Without <root>/.git, commit skips git. R46 key-ownership errors exit 1, not the design's exit 3. Every guessed default is listed in thresholds with source guess.
contract_requests: protocol-model.mjs (built elsewhere) must write completeness/model/result.json as {result: pass|fail|not_run, sha, ...}. gate.mjs reads that file and treats a missing file as not-run.
Unit U5a (gate.mjs) must write the schemas for the stpa, fmea and hazards objects (d_ prefix). Contract section 3.4 hands them to that unit and does not define their fields.

Unit U3b owns tcb/profiles/*.json and unit U4a owns tcb/denylist.txt. The lib unit owns tcb/thresholds.json with the defaults in section 3.20, every tcb/schemas/*.schema.json named in section 3, and tcb/test/helpers.mjs.
open_points: ruling.json uses rule numbers from before R6 was deleted, so they are one higher than the design's numbers (its R39 dismissal bar is the design's R38). The contract cites the design's numbers.

These layer-draft scripts and files are not in the pilot set of 25 and are not built: put.mjs, intent.mjs (owner-message intents only, now status.mjs intent), meter.mjs, spend.mjs, endturn.mjs, merge.mjs, tcb-verify.mjs, make-profile.mjs, events.jsonl, control/epoch, tcb.lock.json.

The coordinator should confirm three things. First, R_same as a second commit step of the research task rather than a separate task row. Second, the alarm re-arming itself. Third, that a committed child's process counts toward slots until stop verify confirms it gone. That third reading is the strict one of R10, and the coordinator must close committed sessions.

These defaults are guesses and need the owner's word or the pilot's measurements: stall c = 30 calls, hang h = 10 ticks, alarm 60 minutes, batch 12, index summary 120 words, fetch caps 10 MiB and 30 s, H_max 2, Z 10 %. B_tokens, r_tokens, unverifiable_share_max, coverage_floor and plants_t are null, meaning they are readings rather than gates, until the owner sets them.

Eleven harness facts cannot be tested without the app (contract section 7); tests skip them with the reason needs-app. The most important for the build: whether the harness names transcript folders the way projectDirName assumes, whether a session's claude.exe command line names its folder or session id (stop and slot counting depend on it), and where a checker's verdict sits in its transcript.

status --endturn must decide whether the watcher's tick is fresh by comparing wall times. It is a liveness check, but the tolerance is not set. Its spec should use 2 times delta plus a margin and put that value in thresholds.
